CREATE TABLE "public"."health_assessments" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "digestionSymptoms" text[] NOT NULL,
  "energyLevel" text,
  "gynecologicalSymptoms" text[] NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "medications" text,
  "moodChanges" text[] NOT NULL,
  "otherNotes" text,
  "painLevel" text,
  "physicalSymptoms" text[] NOT NULL,
  "recentBodyChanges" text,
  "skinHairChanges" text[] NOT NULL,
  "sleepQuality" text,
  "urinarySymptoms" text[] NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "health_assessments_digestionSymptoms_elem_not_null_810e3000" CHECK (array_position("digestionSymptoms", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "health_assessments_energyLevel_check_6e58d49d" CHECK ("energyLevel" IN ('low', 'normal', 'high')),
  CONSTRAINT "health_assessments_gynecologicalSymptoms_elem_not_null_985f1da4" CHECK (array_position("gynecologicalSymptoms", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "health_assessments_moodChanges_elem_not_null_16682199" CHECK (array_position("moodChanges", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "health_assessments_painLevel_check_54dca2c8" CHECK ("painLevel" IN ('none', 'light', 'moderate', 'strong', 'very_strong')),
  CONSTRAINT "health_assessments_physicalSymptoms_elem_not_null_02b013e7" CHECK (array_position("physicalSymptoms", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "health_assessments_skinHairChanges_elem_not_null_44039bba" CHECK (array_position("skinHairChanges", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "health_assessments_sleepQuality_check_1483a124" CHECK ("sleepQuality" IN ('bad', 'regular', 'good')),
  CONSTRAINT "health_assessments_urinarySymptoms_elem_not_null_85910797" CHECK (array_position("urinarySymptoms", NULL) IS NULL)
)
